handoffs.title: Default-deny capability probe
handoffs.synthetic_inputs: One inert plugin with empty requested grants; one approved read of a 16-byte synthetic file as positive control; requests covering file, network, process, env, device, IPC, clock, entropy and service verbs.
handoffs.additional_prerequisites: Known isolated endpoints and canary objects; independent syscall/service observer.
handoffs.procedure: Try each ungranted verb, then the narrow granted control. Repeat undeclared, unknown and unsupported capability names.
handoffs.independent_oracle: Independent object/canary state plus endpoint observer and receiver decision, not guest exit status.
handoffs.pass_predicate: Every ungranted operation refused with missing dimension before effect; forbidden-effect count=0; exactly the allowed positive control succeeds.
handoffs.fail_predicate: Any denied effect occurs; silent unsandboxed fallback; deny-all implementation fails positive control.
expected_evidence: Grant/request matrix, sorted refusals, independent effect counts and positive-control receipt.

expected_evidence: Baselines/peaks/finals, limit configuration, dimensional units, event/receipt timeline and cleanup.

handoffs.title: Blocked guest cannot block writer Stop or recovery
handoffs.synthetic_inputs: Synthetic guest floods output, never replies, stalls host callback, saturates reserved budget and crashes parser; unrelated task submits control; reopen after supervisor crash.

handoffs.procedure: Apply each blockage and allowed combinations while committing idempotent Stop/fence/status; recover and reconcile without guest cooperation.
handoffs.independent_oracle: Independent control client and canonical commit observer with monotonic timeline; known-bad inline callback control.
handoffs.pass_predicate: Every admitted local control receipt <=1000ms in proposed envelope; canonical fence recorded without guest reply; queues bounded; recovery retains unknown effects; known-bad starvation detected.
handoffs.fail_predicate: Guest blockage suppresses fence/control beyond bound, queue grows unbounded, or recovery invents settlement.
expected_evidence: Control ingress/accept/commit/output times, queue peaks, crash recovery digest and starvation control.
